citations.claim: first pole_upright violation: theta=-0.987 rad exceeds 0.8 limit
one step before violation theta=-0.789 still within limit but diverging
two steps before violation theta=-0.601 already falling fast with omega=-9.03

explanation: Noisy sensor (0.02) with coarse dt=0.02 and light cart (0.5) causes controller to saturate at force_limit 30 while cart velocity grows to ~10.9 m/s; pole angular rate diverges to -10.15 rad/s and angle blows past 0.8 rad by step 12. Likely cause is destabilizing feedback under large measurement noise and saturation / delayed discrete control.
vision_note: The blue cart drifts rightward from step 9 to 12 while the pole leans progressively farther to the right. By step 12 the pole is tilted far from upright and its tip turns red, marking the pole_upright violation.
